pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:661 The rot scan consumes the doc map only as document keys and never counts source files that match no entry, so an unmapped share of a tree cannot fail this scan.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:661 Map is doc→prefix only. glob_prefix widens a file glob to its directory; empty sourceGlobs entries are dropped. No inverse coverage walk and no unmapped-area allowlist. Stale verdict cited :649, which is the rescan throttle, not this lookup.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:379 Grep of doc_rot.rs finds no read of onboardingFlows or marketingModule. The scanner's own header types an entry as {doc, sourceGlobs} only, so a missed tour or marketing surface cannot be named here.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:906 Broken outranks stale, and unscoped is unverifiable rather than clean, with a test that the two labels differ. Per-directory omission is scored under checked-vs-skipped, not here.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:294 That take, and collect_docs_tree's return when MAX_DIRS_VISITED trips, drop files with no skipped or not-enumerated count. docs_truncated flips only when the tracked list hits MAX_DOCS_PER_REPO. projects_no_git and unverifiable are separate fields, so the git-absent case is not this gap.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:8 Freshness is one project's local git log of the doc against paths in that same tree. gitlab.rs in this context is connect and deploy, not a watch-set query of another repo.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:365 The coupling registry is a JSON file read as data, not an application module, so the import-the-app failure does not arise. Invalid JSON hits the same continue as a missing file and is not given its own counter.
src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:548 No review-date stamp is written onto the document. Status is recomputed from git commit times; a path absent from the horizon map becomes ts 0.
src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:152 Reads while dirty are counted for ranking. Nothing in this scanner resolves staleness because a document was opened.
src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/doc_rot.rs:199 The tracked population is markdown. Grep of doc_rot.rs for digest, png, or svg found no figure coupling.

pairs.registryProposal: Say explicitly that doc-rot-detection's document-keyed ladder does not discharge source-doc-mapping's inverse coverage gate, and name which checker owes the walk of source files that match no entry.
